journeys.name: Search noise cancelling headphones and verify first product detail page
journeys.user_goal: Search for 'noise cancelling headphones', open the first organic product result and confirm the product title, price and Add to Cart button are visible
preconditions: Public internet access; no login required
No robot-check/captcha interstitial (if one appears, test must fail as BLOCKED, never bypass)
journeys.no_forms_reason: Read-only verification journey. The only input is the single search box submitted via Enter; no multi-field form or dialog is opened, and the Add to Cart button is only asserted visible, never clicked.

steps.observable_result: Home page rendered with the search box visible; no captcha interstitial observed in this session.

steps.action: Fill the searchbox with 'noise cancelling headphones' and press Enter
Click the title link (h2 anchor) of the first organic (non-Sponsored) result card
steps.element: locator('[data-component-type="s-search-result"]').filter({ hasNotText: 'Sponsored' }).first() -> inner h2 link (a:has(h2)); link may have target=_blank and open a new tab/popup — test must handle or strip it
steps.observable_result: First organic result observed: ASIN B0BS74M665, 'Sony WH-CH720N Active Noise Cancellation Wireless Bluetooth Over Ear Headphones...'; navigated to /Sony-Cancellation-Headphones-Multi-Point-Connection/dp/B0BS74M665/ref=sr_1_1.

steps.element: locator('#productTitle') — a span inside the single page heading; getByRole('heading').filter({ has: locator('#productTitle') }) matched exactly 1
steps.observable_result: Title visible: 'Sony WH-CH720N Active Noise Cancellation Wireless Bluetooth Over Ear Headphones with Mic, Adaptive S...' (offsetParent !== null).

steps.element: locator('#corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole') with sibling .a-price-symbol; note: .a-price .a-offscreen textContent is EMPTY on this page — do not assert on .a-offscreen

steps.action: Verify Add to Cart button is visible (DO NOT click)
steps.element: getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }) — matched exactly 1 (input#add-to-cart-button, value 'Add to cart', aria-labelledby submit.add-to-cart-announce). Non-exact name also matches a hidden shortcuts-menu button 'Add to cart, shift, option, K', so exact: true is required
steps.observable_result: Add to Cart button visible (isVisible() === true).

evidence_notes: Live exploration 2026-11-24 ~19:25 IST via playwright-cli chromium; all locator facts verified with targeted eval/run-code checks (atcExactCount=1, titleHeading=1, atcVisible=true, price whole '7,989' symbol '₹').
caveats: Amazon result order is dynamic; the 'first organic product' changes between sessions. Assert generic visibility, not the Sony-specific title text.
Anti-bot: after goto, check body text for /robot check|captcha|type the characters|verify you are human/i and fail BLOCKED if matched.
Product title link can open in a new tab (target=_blank) depending on card template; handle popup or use the href navigation.

frontier.element: Add to Cart click / cart flow
frontier.reason_not_visited: Out of scope: read-only verification; mutating a public retail cart is not authorized.

exploration_limits: Single journey scoped to the requested scenario; public site, unauthenticated, read-only.
observations: amazon.in PDP: #productTitle (span in single h1 heading), visible price via #corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole (a-offscreen empty), Add to Cart = input#add-to-cart-button with accessible name 'Add to cart' (exact match unique).
